companyRegistration.businessFlowTitle: Jobs go through request, audit, and HR
companyRegistration.businessFlowDescription: The Department Head requests the job with all details. The Executive Office or Audit reviews salary, reward, and financial notes. After approval, Human Resources publishes the job and manages candidates. The Company Administrator monitors departments and the general dashboard.
